# Frozen uniform-gauge compatibility inputs

Generated from the actual app/tests source tree at `a64490c9d5777c714a6c02e265197d836ec81228`, using `git archive` into an isolated directory and the locked Python environment. The generating code calls `tests.test_head_opening.reference()`, opens the head to 16 stitches, and saves the arm progress with `project_backup`. A separate trial ZIP is made with `create_trial_bundle` and a synthetic saved 28×30 swatch through `update_trial_bundle`.

These are synthetic software fixtures for one design. No doll was made or measured; the swatch flag exercises saved-state code and is not physical-trial evidence. There are no photos or personal data. The project has no per-part gauge fields. Tests require its revision/progress/notes to remain intact and the trial's exact source bytes and SHA to survive recovery and density preview.
